summary.headline: KS Industry plans KRW 5bn third-party rights offering at KRW 685 per share
summary.what_happened: On Nov 26, 2026, KS Industry's board approved a third-party allotment rights offering of 7,299,270 common shares at KRW 685 per share, with payment due Dec 4, 2026. The shares are to be allotted to Prime Light Investment Fund No. 1, and the proceeds are designated entirely for operating funds. The company stated that the new shares will be subject to a one-year mandatory lock-up and expects listing on Dec 21, 2026.
summary.why_it_matters: Third-party allotment rights offerings in Korea give new shares to selected investors rather than existing shareholders pro rata, which can dilute existing holders' ownership and per-share value depending on the issue price relative to market price. Lock-up periods limit when new holders can resell those shares.
